inputs.description: Your own Metroid Prime (USA, Rev 2, GM8E01) disc image. You import it in EctoPad after installing; the build does not read it.

tools.name: rustup
tools.note: Install Rust with rustup and add the iPhone target; see PadMint's before-build line for this game.

tools.name: xcodebuild
tools.note: Install Xcode 26 or newer with its iOS platform, then select it in Xcode Settings > Locations > Command Line Tools; Command Line Tools alone are not enough.

tools.name: xcrun
tools.label: Xcode iPhoneOS SDK
tools.note: Install Xcode 26 or newer with its iOS platform, then select it in Xcode Settings > Locations > Command Line Tools; Command Line Tools alone are not enough.

publication.reason: EctoPad publishes source; each player builds and signs their own copy. The Metroid Prime disc image is imported in the app.
